## Confirmed API Facts (available in context — usable for tests)
- `devpilot/core/message.py`:
  - `Role = Literal["assistant","user","tool"]`
  - `@dataclass ToolCall: id: str; name: str; arguments: dict[str, Any]`
  - `@dataclass Message: role: Role; content: str = ""; tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = field(default_factory=list); tool_call_id: str | None = None`
- `devpilot/tools/base.py`:
  - `ToolHandler = Callable[[dict[str, Any]], str]`
  - `@dataclass Tool: name: str; description: str; parameters: dict[str, Any]; handler: ToolHandler`
  - `Tool.schema()` returns OpenAI function-calling schema dict: `{"type":"function","function":{"name","description","parameters"}}`
- `devpilot/tools/registry.py` — `ToolRegistry`:
  - `register(tool: Tool)` → raises `ValueError` on duplicate name
  - `get(name) -> Tool | None`
  - `schemas() -> list[dict]`
  - `names() -> list[str]`
- `devpilot/tools/hooks.py` — `HookManager`:
  - `register_pre_tool_use(hook: Callable[[ToolCall], str | None])`
  - `register_post_tool_use(hook: Callable[[ToolCall, str], None])`
  - `run_pre_tool_use(tool_call) -> str | None` (returns first non-None hook result, else None)
  - `run_post_tool_use(tool_call, result)` (runs all post hooks)
- **Important**: `devpilot/tools/permissions.py` — `PermissionPolicy.check` currently **`return None` early**; the real logic is commented out. Tests must account for this (permissions are effectively a no-op right now).
- `devpilot/core/model.py` contains a `MockModel` (confirmed available for LLM-free tests).

- `PROJECT_STATE.md` (consistent), `pyproject.toml`
- `devpilot/core/`: `message.py`, `model.py` (MockModel), `agent.py`
- `devpilot/tools/`: `base.py`, `registry.py`, `hooks.py` (full contents captured); `dispatcher.py`, `permissions.py` read but results omitted in places
- `devpilot/context/`: `todo.py`, `manager.py`, `compact.py`, `skills.py`, `transcript.py`
- `devpilot/memory/`: `extractor.py`, `consolidate.py`, `manager.py`, `store.py`, `recall.py`
- `devpilot/tasks/`: `model.py`, `store.py`, `graph.py`, `scheduler.py`
- `devpilot/tools/builtin/*`
- `tests/v1_agent.py` — this is a **runner script**, not a proper test: it calls `agent.run(...)` with a live `DeepSeekModel()` and references an undefined `response` (would fail). Not usable as an LLM-free test as-is.
- Git log/status; directory listings.

- First command failed: `pwd`/`ls` not recognized — shell is Windows `cmd`. Switched to `dir /b`, `type`, `for %f`.
- `tests/v1_agent.py` uses a live model call and has an undefined variable (`response`) — not usable as an LLM-free test.
- **Repeated tool-result omission**: many `read_file`/`type` calls for the same files (notably `memory/store.py`, `memory/recall.py`, `core/agent.py`, `tasks/*`, `context/*`, `tools/dispatcher.py`, `tools/permissions.py`, `tools/builtin/*`) were issued repeatedly but their results kept getting omitted from active context, causing a loop of re-reads. Only `tools/base.py`, `tools/registry.py`, `tools/hooks.py`, and `core/message.py` fully survived.
